subtopics.title: Data Quality Dimensions
subtopics.summary: Defining data quality for finetuning using dimensions such as completeness, uniqueness, validity, accuracy, consistency, and fitness for purpose.

subtopics.title: Annotation Consistency
subtopics.summary: Ensuring annotations are consistent across examples and annotators to avoid confusing the model during training.

subtopics.title: Annotation Guidelines and Fact-Checking
subtopics.summary: Creating annotation guidelines, updating them based on feedback, and fact-checking annotations to correct factual errors.

subtopics.title: Data Cleaning and Filtering
subtopics.summary: Removing extraneous formatting tokens, PII, sensitive data, copyrighted data, and toxic content to ensure dataset safety and performance.

subtopics.title: Manual Data Inspection
subtopics.summary: Manually inspecting data to verify annotation trustworthiness, check example uniqueness, and identify inconsistencies.
